request.style: English, female voice, solo with choir, piano, cello, drums, strings, dark and intense, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Two women daughters of one mother
Played the whore in Egypt
Oholah and Oholibah
Bore sons and daughters

[Verse]
She burned with lust for Assyrians
Handsome young men on horses
She defiled herself with idols
Stripped naked by the sword

[Chorus]
I am about to rouse your lovers
Bring them against you
They will judge you by their laws
Cut off your nose and ears

[Verse]
Her sister saw and lusted more
After the Chaldeans
Figures carved in vermilion
Belts around their waists

[Chorus]
I am about to rouse your lovers
Bring them against you
They will judge you by their laws
Cut off your nose and ears

[Bridge]
Blood is on their hands
Offered children to idols
Defiled my sanctuary
Profaned my Sabbaths

[Chorus]
I am about to rouse your lovers
Bring them against you
They will judge you by their laws
Cut off your nose and ears

[Outro]
Drink the cup of horror
Gnaw its broken pieces
